title: bonsai.lanes/1
description: Lane definitions (contract §6): the lanes a pack defines and the two rules Bonsai's base understands for each. A YAML pack file, written by a pack (Bonsai's base defines none); read by Bonsai (bonsai check, the guard), the studio (through status --json) and agents (each description). A task's lane field names one of these. A writer writes every field below, in this order (contract §2.2); a reader treats a missing field as null and keeps an unknown one. The file follows the format-1 YAML rules (contract §2.4), and as a pack file it documents itself in # comments (contract §2.8).

format.description: The version line, always the first key (contract §2.2).

lanes.description: The lanes this pack defines, one entry each.

examples.name: light
examples.description: Small fixes and docs. Build it, climb the ladder, merge.

name.description: The lane's name, as a task's lane field writes it.

approve_first.description: A rule base understands (contract §6, a closed list of two): when true, a move to running, verify or done needs the task to have read approved since it last read todo or plan.

close.description: The other rule base understands (contract §6): who may move the task to done, person or agent.

description.description: What agents read about the lane: everything the two rules do not say (contract §6).
examples: A decision, not code. Write the options and stop; a person chooses.
